Existence of DiagnosticSessionControl . diagnostic- Session The idea of modeling the sub-function of DiagnosticSessionControl by means of the reference DiagnosticSessionControl . diagnosticSession implies that the applicable DiagnosticSession already exists at the time when the given DiagnosticSessionControl is created.
